verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents alerting over voice call, SMS, e-mail and push notifications, with phone-call acknowledgment by pressing 1, so all four channels the story names are covered. Nothing shows an engineer choosing their own channels or setting per-channel notification rules; escalation policies set who is alerted and in what order, not which channel. missing for 10: user-selectable channel preferences, per-channel notification rules (e.g., delays or ordering per channel), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, pages reach me over the channels I choose — push, SMS, phone call, and email — with per-channel notification rules

citations.quote: Unlimited voice call alerts As well as SMS, e-mail, Slack, Teams, and push notifications with our all-you-can-alert pricing.
When Uptime calls you, you are prompted to press 1 to acknowledge the incident.
Acknowledge them with a single tap and stop your phone from ringing.
